_comment: Single source of truth for shadcn reference cases. tools/shadcn/capture_shadcn_local.py renders each id from the local reference app; tools/shadcn/reference-app/src/cases.tsx must declare a matching id (the capture reports FAIL if it does not). Adding a case is one row here plus one entry there -- no tiling, no hand-matched framing.

cases.why: All six shadcn button variants in declaration order.
Default and outline icon-only buttons plus an outline icon-and-label button; verifies icon dimensions, button sizes, gap, and compact icon-bearing padding.
sm/default/lg -- the heights our hardcoded 40dp fallbacks get compared against.
A state no docs demo exposes; our disabled rendering had no reference at all.
Pinned ButtonGroup with two outline buttons; verifies joined borders, per-corner radii, zero inter-button gap, and content-hugging width.
Pinned vertical ButtonGroup at a fixed 156px width; verifies full-width members, collapsed top border, and top/bottom-only outer corners.
Badge variants, including the ghost/link pair the variant audit flagged.
Unchecked, checked and disabled -- the disabled state no docs demo exposes.
Three inline radio/label rows, with the middle option selected.
Two primary-on-muted progress indicators at 25% and 65%.
Off, on and disabled, without the label the docs demo carries.
Placeholder, typed and disabled, matching what our field preview renders.
A two-tab track with the first selected.
A single-thumb slider at 50, for the knob-size gap the harness measured.
Closed trigger showing its placeholder, matching our select preview.
Open Select content with Banana selected; proves the popup, Select-specific item inset, and selection indicator.
Open Select content with a later item selected; proves overflow scrolling keeps every row's text and indicator separated.
The login card our card preview renders: title, label, input, full-width button.
An open tooltip -- a state the scraped docs page could only be caught in by accident.
An open dialog with title, description and a save action, matching our dialog preview.
Placeholder, multi-line typed text and disabled states.
Off, on, and disabled pressable toggle buttons.
Default and destructive alert banners.
Initials avatar fallbacks.
Inline breadcrumb link trail.
Expanded collapsible panel.
Inline key-cap badges.
Placeholder loading pulse blocks.
Loading spinner indicator.
Open dropdown menu content.
Open popover content panel.
Empty state: title, description and an action slot.
Two panels sharing a drag handle -- the geometry Studio's workspace splitter mirrors.
